title: Act 2 - Chapter 2: Azalea Town & Ilex Forest (Hive Badge)
synopsis: Traverse the dense canopy of Ilex Forest to discover Azalea Town submerged in floodwaters. Acquire HM06 Dive from Kurt, solve the 4-Slowpoke evolution puzzle inside Slowpoke Well to drain the town, and duel Leader Kurt for the Hive Badge.
